en.headline: Mark Six draw leaves first prize unclaimed as jackpot rolls to Saturday
en.dek: The Hong Kong Jockey Club said the numbers drawn on Tuesday night were 1, 20, 26, 28, 35 and 41 with special number 36, and the estimated first prize for Saturday's draw rises to about HK$102 million.
body: The Hong Kong Jockey Club said there was no winner in the first division of Tuesday night's Mark Six draw, draw number 26/124.
The numbers drawn were 1, 20, 26, 28, 35 and 41, with special number 36. Six bets won the second prize of HK$1,140,540 each, while 190 bets shared the third prize of HK$96,040.
Total turnover for the draw reached HK$174,585,844. With no first-prize winner, the estimated jackpot for the next draw on Saturday 28 November rises to about HK$102 million.
Ticket sales for Saturday's draw close at 9.15pm, with the draw at 9.30pm.

zh.headline: 六合彩頭獎無人中 獎金撥入周六金多寶約1.02億
zh.dek: 馬會表示周二晚上攪出號碼為1、20、26、28、35及41，特別號碼36，周六攪珠估計頭獎升至約1.02億元。
body: 香港賽馬會表示，周二晚上舉行的六合彩第26/124期攪珠，頭獎無人中。
攪出號碼為1、20、26、28、35及41，特別號碼36。二獎有6注中，每注獎金114萬540元；三獎有190注中，每注獎金9萬6040元。
是期總投注額達1億7458萬5844元。由於頭獎無人中，獎金撥入下期，周六11月28日攪珠的估計頭獎約為1.02億元。
周六攪珠售票於晚上9時15分截止，9時30分攪珠。
